newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end off highs, focus on telecoms.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end off highs, focus on telecoms.

text.p: 1725 GMT - Portuguese shares ended off the session's highs as the market eased in response to New York's weaker opening on profit-taking. Telecommunications firms Portugal Telecom and Telecel accounted for a third of the total turnover on Lisbon bourse of 11.5 billion escudos. Dealers said they expected a calmer session on Wednesday as some investors took profits. "Tomorrow the market should calm down," one dealer said. "I think that at the present levels we are going to see some selling. There was a softening today, but nothing too significant," he added.
